'''Brii'n Dalei''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and member of the [[Black Bha'lir]]. Dalei told stories of his adventures to a young [[Drake Paulsen]], and recorded them in a journal. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dalei was killed in space by [[Sector/Legends|sector]] authorities. His passing was marked by a ceremony at the [[Judges of the Dead]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="BSS" />
